name: Mobile Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for building production-quality mobile applications with React Native or Flutter: UI, offline-first patterns, performance, platform permissions, and app store readiness.
useCases: Build React Native or Flutter screens with production-quality UI and accessibility.
Implement offline-first data handling and platform permission flows correctly.
Profile and fix mobile performance issues and prepare an app for store submission.
examplePrompts: Implement this screen in React Native with offline support and proper permission handling.
This Flutter list view janks on low-end Android devices — profile it and fix the performance problems.
